university.name: COMSATS University Islamabad
university.campuses_text: Islamabad Main Campus; Lahore Campus; Abbottabad Campus; Wah Campus; Attock Campus; Sahiwal Campus; Vehari Campus
university.tagline: Excellence in Higher Education, Innovative Research and Service to Society
university.hero_subtitle: Chartered public research university by the Federal Government of Pakistan with 7 physical campuses and a Virtual Campus (NOC pending with HEC) nationwide
university.about_text: COMSATS University Islamabad (CUI) is a public sector university chartered by the Federal Government of Pakistan in 2018 (originally established as CIIT in 1998). CUI functions under the governance of the Ministry of Science and Technology. The university comprises 7 physical campuses - Islamabad (Main Campus), Lahore, Abbottabad, Wah Cantt, Attock, Sahiwal, and Vehari - plus a Virtual Campus that is currently not operational and is seeking HEC NOC to launch distance learning programs. It hosts 6 faculties, 23 academic departments, 6 research centers, and over 39,000 enrolled students. CUI has consistently ranked among top national universities and leading international institutions according to Times Higher Education (THE) and QS World University Rankings.
university.mission: The COMSATS University Islamabad, founded in the belief that understanding enriches all people, is dedicated to the search for truth through advancement of learning and extending the frontiers of knowledge; to the sharing of this knowledge through education in an academically diverse range of disciplines and subjects; and to the application of this knowledge to benefit the people of Pakistan, the Muslim Ummah, and the World, at large.
university.mission_statement: The COMSATS University Islamabad, founded in the belief that understanding enriches all people, is dedicated to the search for truth through advancement of learning and extending the frontiers of knowledge; to the sharing of this knowledge through education in an academically diverse range of disciplines and subjects; and to the application of this knowledge to benefit the people of Pakistan, the Muslim Ummah, and the World, at large.
university.vision: The COMSATS University Islamabad envisions assuming a truly national character for itself in the years to come. It envisions having presence in all provinces of the country. It sees for itself a position among the top five universities in the country; among top 100 universities in the developing countries and top 300, 200, 100 universities in the world respectively in the 5, 10 and 15-years' time horizon.

campuses.name: COMSATS University Islamabad – Islamabad Campus
campuses.address: Park Road, Tarlai Kalan, Islamabad, 45550, Pakistan
campuses.description: The principal campus of COMSATS University Islamabad, established in 1998, providing a vibrant and cutting-edge environment for advanced teaching, world-class research, and technology incubation.
campuses.why_choose: Federal capital location, top HEC & THE ranked research faculty, extensive laboratories, high-tech incubation center, and nationwide career opportunities.

campuses.name: COMSATS University Islamabad – Lahore Campus
campuses.address: Defence Road, Off Raiwind Road, Lahore, 54000, Pakistan
campuses.description: Established in 2002, the Lahore campus spans 185 acres of landscaped grounds and features state-of-the-art academic complexes, modern hostels, and dedicated engineering centers.
campuses.why_choose: Expansive 185-acre campus, premier engineering and computing programs, strong corporate linkage with Lahore industrial hub, and vibrant student life.

campuses.name: COMSATS University Islamabad – Abbottabad Campus
campuses.address: University Road, Tobe Camp, Abbottabad, 22060, Pakistan
campuses.description: Established in 2001 amidst scenic pine hills, Abbottabad campus is renowned for Pharmacy, Earth Sciences, Environmental Sciences, and Electrical Engineering.
campuses.why_choose: Serene mountain study environment, strong pharmacy and biotechnology research base, purpose-built on-campus hostels housing over 780 students.

campuses.name: COMSATS University Islamabad – Wah Campus
campuses.address: G.T. Road, Quaid Avenue, Wah Cantt, 47040, Pakistan
campuses.description: Established in 2001 in the industrial hub of Wah Cantt, this campus specializes in Engineering, Computing, and Management Sciences.
campuses.why_choose: Strategic GT Road access, strong linkages with Heavy Industries Taxila and POF, high graduate placement in manufacturing and tech sectors.

campuses.name: COMSATS University Islamabad – Attock Campus
campuses.description: Established in 2004 to provide high-quality tertiary education to students from northern Punjab and KPK, focusing on Computing, Management, and Mathematics.
campuses.why_choose: Affordable quality education close to home, modern computer labs, high teacher-to-student ratio, and peaceful academic atmosphere.

campuses.name: COMSATS University Islamabad – Sahiwal Campus
campuses.address: COMSATS Road, Off G.T. Road, Sahiwal, 57000, Pakistan
campuses.description: Established in 2006, serving central Punjab with purpose-built classrooms, modern auditoriums, sports grounds, and specialized research facilities.
campuses.why_choose: Premier institution in Sahiwal division, purpose-built infrastructure, on-campus hostels, and specialized Bioscience and CS programs.

campuses.name: COMSATS University Islamabad – Vehari Campus
campuses.address: Mailsi Road, Off Multan Road, Vehari, 61100, Pakistan
campuses.description: Established in 2008, bringing prestigious science and technology higher education to southern Punjab agricultural belt.
campuses.why_choose: Subsidized fee structure, dedicated girls hostel, high scholarship coverage (PEEF/HEC/CUI Need-based), and focus on agricultural and environmental sciences.

campuses.name: COMSATS University Islamabad – Virtual Campus
campuses.address: Park Road, Tarlai Kalan, Islamabad, 45550, Pakistan
campuses.description: The Virtual Campus is currently in the process of seeking an NOC from HEC to launch distance and online programs. It is not yet operational and is not currently offering admissions. Plans are underway to launch three undergraduate programs in Spring 2027.
campuses.why_choose: Virtual Campus is not yet operational. CUI is seeking HEC NOC for distance learning and plans to launch 3 undergraduate programs in Spring 2027.
campuses.noc_status: pending - seeking HEC NOC for distance learning programs
